description: AllocateNet + RefundAmountForUnits golden vectors. Integers only (whole rupiah). Shared with the TypeScript twin (apps/pos/src/cashier/allocate.ts). allocations: lines[].base is the line subtotal as priced, components[] are order-level discounts applied in order (eligible = line indices, null = every line), total is the stored order total (after tax, surcharge, rounding, redeemed points). expectedNets is aligned to lines; ok=false means no valid allocation (expectedNets omitted). refunds: steps[] are units returned per refund in sequence of a line with the given net/qty; expectedAmounts[i] = cum(prior+k)-cum(prior), cum(n) = n==qty ? net : floor(net*n/qty). Component eligible entries are ARRAY POSITIONS into lines[], not lineNo values; lineNo is only the remainder tie-break key (lower lineNo wins). eligible null or absent = every line; eligible [] = no line (the component is a no-op and its amount falls through to the residual spread).

allocations.name: scoped promo only discounts its line
stacked codes plus manual, remainder to lowest line
redeem points reduce total (negative residual) with tie-break
zero priced line stays zero under surcharge
rounding up spreads one rupiah-block with tie to lowest line
bxgy same-set discount over counted lines only
bundle or bxgy separate-set repriced lines carry their own base
component above eligible base is clamped
non-contiguous line numbers keep tie order by lineNo
all lines free but positive total has no allocation
large vector: products exceed int64 and 2^53, needs big-int math
eligible empty array: component affects no line
eligible null means every line (same amount as the empty-array case)
eligible key absent means every line
non-contiguous lineNo with scoped component: eligible are positions, tie goes to lower lineNo

refunds.name: three units one at a time, last settles remainder

notes: Beyond the pure allocator, the TS twin must reproduce these server rules (service/allocate.go).
Component order: each promo/code in stack order (calcPromotionDiscount amounts), then the manual discount last.
Cumulative cap: the running sum of component amounts is capped at the cart subtotal, so a cap overflow trims the LAST components (manual) first.
Each component amount and each line base is rounded to whole rupiah with Math.round semantics of Go math.Round (half away from zero; use sign-aware rounding in JS, not Math.round for negatives).

Whole-rupiah skip: if the stored order total differs from its rounded value by more than 0.004, or a line index is duplicated/negative/above 32767, no allocation is made (line data stays null, order is whole-order refund only).

Eligibility: scoped percentage/fixed/BOGO promos match lines by productId in applicableProductIds (not variant-aware); BXGY same-set matches buyProductIds via pid or pid|size, empty list = every line; tiered, whole-cart promos and manual = every line. Bundle and BXGY separate-set promos contribute 0 (their repricing is already in the line base).

refund_group keys: only validated bundle / BXGY separate-set reward lines start a group, key '<kind>:<promotionId>:1' (kind bundle|bxgy). Paid lines join a group when they match a bundle slot, or the BXGY buy set (empty buy list = any line outside the get set). Groups that share a paid line MERGE into one group; every member gets the lexicographically smallest of the merged keys. Loyalty reward lines get no group. The C3 giveaway is not a line.
line_no is the 0-based index in the sale payload items (before reward-line compaction).
